items.detail: PASS: watchDaemon at specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts:133 subscribes daemon.on('task'), dedups via inFlight Set + lastDispatchedAt Map with ttlMs (default 10min, line 137), key = kind|triggerPath, skips empty trigger, dispatches via this.invoker.invoke, clears inFlight in .finally. Daemon emits 'task' at specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/daemon.ts:188 with AgentTask {kind,trigger,spec,target} (types.ts:26-32) — payload shape matches. invocation.ts:59-75 resolves repoRoot = path.resolve(__dirname,'..','..','..','..') = /home/kara/speclang (verified via node -e), candidates SPECLANG_BIN / <repo>/bin/speclang / 'speclang'; bin/speclang exists and is executable (ls -l). invocation.ts:104-113 surfaces real errors: lastError includes cmd+code+message+stderr, returns success:false with error for non-ENOENT. Build: `npm run build` BUILD_RC=0. Suite: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` VITEST_RC=0, "Tests 1848 passed | 58 skipped (1906)". · graded at iteration 94.6 (744,911 in / 3,569 out, 94.6 iterations and 210s into the run)

FAIL: watchDaemon has no caller anywhere in the repo. `grep -rn watchDaemon` matches only its definition (specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts:133) and a comment (invocation.ts:97). The shipped daemon entrypoints bin/speclangd (foreground start at bin/speclangd:121-146, background spawn) and specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/speclangd.ts:40-56 only attach `d.on('task', task => console.log('[CLI] Task generated:', ...))` — they never construct a CascadeCoordinator nor call watchDaemon. `grep -rn "watchDaemon|AgentInvoker|invoke(" bin/speclangd bin/speclang specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/*.ts` returns nothing. So the DF-SPECLANG-015 defect (routed tasks produce no agent session) is unchanged in production; the new method is dead code reachable only by a caller that does not exist. · graded at iteration 98.1 (0 in / 0 out, 0.1 iterations and 218s into the run)

FAIL: AgentInvoker.invoke (specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/invocation.ts:139-152) builds InvocationResult without copying `output` from the executor result, and InvocationResult (invocation.ts:17-30) has no `output` field. Proven by probe: injected executor returning {success:true, files:[], output:'GENERATED SPEC CONTENT'} -> invoke() returns HAS_OUTPUT=false, OUTPUT=undefined. Therefore watchDaemon's write branch (index.ts:177-186, `const output = (invocation as any).output; if (task.target && output && ...) fs.writeFileSync(task.target, output)`) can never fire — the routed spec_writer output is never persisted to the task target. · graded at iteration 98.0 (102,670 in / 939 out, 3.4 iterations and 218s into the run)

PASS (with caveat): dedup TTL is time-bounded, not permanent — index.ts:137 ttlMs default 10*60*1000, index.ts:150-153 skips only while Date.now()-last < ttlMs, so a re-converged file is re-dispatched after the TTL; inFlight entry is removed in .finally (index.ts:190-192) so a failed/completed dispatch does not block forever. Caveat: the key is `${kind}|${triggerPath}` only (index.ts:143) — content changes within the TTL window are suppressed, which is the documented intent of the TTL. · graded at iteration 99.2 (35,339 in / 196 out, 1.1 iterations and 219s into the run)
